name: Exp_Trading_Channel_Index
summary: This EA trades based on the Channel Index indicator, entering positions when price breaks out of the calculated channel boundaries. It systematically opens buy trades on upper channel breakouts and sell trades on lower channel breakouts, with configurable take-profit and stop-loss levels.
summary_zh: 该EA基于通道指数指标进行交易，当价格突破计算得出的通道边界时开仓。在通道上轨突破时系统性地开多单，下轨突破时开空单，并设有可配置的止盈止损水平。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略是基于通道指数指标的突破交易系统。通道指数通过计算价格在一定周期内的波动范围来确定上下通道边界，当价格突破上轨时产生做多信号，突破下轨时产生做空信号。入场条件依赖于价格与通道边界的相对位置关系，突破确认后即开仓交易。出场条件包括预设的止盈和止损水平，确保每笔交易都有明确的风险收益比。仓位管理方面，EA使用固定手数进行交易，没有动态仓位调整机制。资金管理较为基础，缺乏根据账户余额或风险比例自动计算仓位的功能，交易者需要手动设置合适的交易量。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is a breakout trading system based on the Channel Index indicator. The Channel Index calculates price volatility boundaries over a defined period to establish upper and lower channel limits. Entry signals are generated when price breaks above the upper channel line for buy positions and below the lower channel line for sell positions. Exit conditions rely on pre-set take-profit and stop-loss levels, ensuring each trade has a defined risk-reward ratio. Position sizing uses fixed lot sizes without dynamic adjustment, meaning the EA does not scale positions based on account equity or volatility. Money management is relatively basic, lacking automatic lot calculation based on account balance or risk percentage, requiring traders to manually configure appropriate trade sizes.

parameters.name: MagicNumber
parameters.description: EA魔术编号，用于标识订单
parameters.description_en: EA magic number for identifying orders

pros: 策略逻辑清晰简单，基于通道突破的原理容易理解和验证
每笔交易都设有止损止盈，风险控制有基本保障
使用魔术编号管理订单，避免与其他EA冲突
pros_en: Clear and simple strategy logic based on channel breakout principles that are easy to understand and verify
Each trade has stop-loss and take-profit set, providing basic risk control guarantees
Uses magic number for order management, avoiding conflicts with other EAs
cons: 固定手数交易，缺乏动态仓位管理，无法根据市场波动调整风险敞口
通道指标在震荡行情中容易产生虚假突破信号，导致频繁止损
没有加入新K线检查机制，可能在同一根K线上重复开仓
cons_en: Fixed lot sizing lacks dynamic position management, unable to adjust risk exposure based on market volatility
Channel indicator prone to false breakout signals in ranging markets, leading to frequent stop-loss hits
No new bar check mechanism, potentially opening multiple positions on the same candle
improvements: 增加动态仓位管理，根据ATR或账户风险比例自动计算交易手数
加入新K线检查和信号过滤机制，避免虚假突破和重复开仓
improvements_en: Add dynamic position sizing that automatically calculates lot size based on ATR or account risk percentage
Implement new bar check and signal filtering mechanisms to avoid false breakouts and duplicate entries

risk_points: 缺乏新K线检查机制，可能在同一根K线上多次开仓导致过度交易
固定手数无法适应不同市场波动环境，高波动时风险敞口可能过大
risk_points_en: Lack of new bar check may cause multiple entries on the same candle, leading to overtrading
Fixed lot size cannot adapt to varying market volatility environments, potentially creating excessive risk exposure during high volatility
